verdict.rationale: Ramp documents funds with restrictions on amount, interval, allowed merchant categories, allowed merchants and countries. It also claims it can "enforce spend limits, and block risky merchants or categories all before spend happens," and per-vendor limits on virtual cards are cited, which covers restriction by category, merchant and amount plus pre-transaction blocking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how authorizations are declined at the point of sale, any documented automatic card locking when spend is out of policy (only manual lock via MCP/CLI is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
